entities.name: PMID:27489950
observations: Lankelma et al., Clinical and Translational Gastroenterology (2016); DOI 10.1038/ctg.2016.43.

In 12 healthy young men, 7 days of oral ciprofloxacin, vancomycin, and metronidazole reduced gut microbial diversity and lowered ex vivo LPS-stimulated TNF-α production by isolated mononuclear cells one day after treatment; responsiveness recovered six weeks later.

entities.name: Broad-spectrum antibiotics
observations: Seven-day combination regimen in the primary study: ciprofloxacin 500 mg twice daily, vancomycin 500 mg three times daily, and metronidazole 500 mg three times daily.

entities.name: Reduced TNF-alpha release
observations: Healthy adults showed lower TNF-α production by isolated mononuclear cells after ex vivo lipopolysaccharide stimulation one day after antibiotic treatment; the effect was restored six weeks after cessation.
